titles.original_title: Laaga Chunari Mein Daag: Journey of a Woman
titles.plot: A girl from Varanasi travels to Mumbai in order to support her financially crippled family. She turns into a high-profile escort and struggles to hide her profession from her sister.

titles.title: A Beautiful Life
titles.plot: A teenage runaway (Angela Sarafyan) falls in love with an illegal immigrant (Jesse Garcia) who works in a Los Angeles strip club.

titles.title: Salaam Namaste
titles.plot: A chef (Saif Ali Khan) and a medical student (Preity Zinta) test their compatibility by living together for a year.

titles.title: 1 Night
titles.plot: Past and present collide as two couples explore love over the course of one night at a hotel. Thirty-something Elizabeth must decide whether to salvage her relationship with Drew after much personal disappointment. Meanwhile, Bea, a worrisome teenager, reconnects with her introverted childhood friend, Andy, to overcome their difference in high school status following their prom.

titles.title: A Novel Romance
titles.plot: Nate (Steve Guttenberg) and Jenny (Milena Govich) meet in a restaurant and seem to bond. They are both stuck in bad relationships and part ways until Nate's girlfriend dumps him and Jenny's boyfriend overdoses.

titles.title: A Rocky Mountain Affair
titles.plot: After a minor car accident, an event planner from the city gets lost in the Rocky Mountains and is rescued by a handsome guide on horseback. They clash at first, but as an attraction grows, they learn that anything is possible.

titles.title: About Pie
titles.plot: A young man's love of pie fuels a series of misadventures in modern romance.

titles.title: Detours of Love
titles.plot: Handsome world traveler Raj (Ranbir Kapoor) recounts a decade of casual romance, including a tryst with the beautiful Mahi (Minissha Lamba) in Switzerland and with model Radhika (Bipasha Basu) in Mumbai. Now living in Sydney, Australia, the historically commitment-phobic Raj finds himself wanting to settle down for real with his latest love, gorgeous taxi driver Gayatri (Deepika Padukone). But, as the two grow closer, Raj worries that his promiscuous past will come back to haunt him.

titles.title: Befikre
titles.plot: Two commitment-phobic individuals enter into a casual relationship that turns out to be fraught with more emotion than they can handle. They drift apart, only to be drawn back together.

titles.title: Between Love & Goodbye
titles.plot: A manipulative sibling moves in and tries to break up her gay brother's (Simon Miller) romance with a French immigrant (Justin Tensen).

titles.title: Bobby
titles.plot: A young man gives up seminary school when he falls in love with a woman.

titles.title: Boxing Day
titles.plot: Melvin (Aml Ameen), a British author living in America returns home to London for Christmas to introduce his American fiancée Lisa (Aja Naomi King) to his eccentric British-Caribbean family. Their relationship is put to the test, as she discovers the world her fiancé has left behind.

titles.title: The Bridges of Madison County
titles.plot: A moving love story about a photographer on assignment to shoot the historic bridges of Madison County. He meets a housewife, whose husband and children are away on a trip, and the film traces a brief affair that is never sordid but instead one of two soul mates who have met too late.

images.caption: Meryl Streep as Francesca Johnson in "The Bridges of Madison County."
Meryl Streep as Francesca Johnson in "The Bridges of Madison County."

titles.title: Casomai
titles.plot: When Tommaso (Fabio Volo), a successful Italian advertising executive, and Stefania (Stefania Rocca), a makeup artist, decide to get married, they opt for a rustic wedding outside of Milan. At the ceremony, the priest talks about the ups and downs of relationships, and both are depicted, as the film looks back at Tommaso and Stefania's courtship and forward to their future. As their relationship is traced, the movie touches on romance, infidelity and parenthood, among other topics.

titles.title: Delight
titles.plot: A former war photographer's intense affair with a younger man in a remote Welsh village forces her to exorcise the ghosts of her past.

titles.title: Design for Living
titles.plot: Painter George (Gary Cooper) and playwright Thomas (Fredric March) are two Americans sharing a Paris apartment. They're also rivals for the affection of commercial artist Gilda (Miriam Hopkins). When the plucky Gilda moves in, with the express understanding that there will be no funny business, the rivalry between George and Thomas heats up even further. Then Thomas heads to London when one of his plays is being produced there, leaving George free to make his move.

titles.title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
titles.plot: Raj and Simran meet on a trip to Europe. After some initial misadventures, they fall in love. The battle begins to win over two traditional families.

titles.title: The Four of Us
titles.plot: After their partner swap experiment takes a turn, four friends arrive at a remote beach hut to face the fallout and purge themselves of deeper truths.

titles.title: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
titles.plot: Prem, a school dropout, hesitantly marries an educated but overweight girl, Sandhya. The two come closer when they take part in a race, which involves Prem carrying Sandhya on his back.

titles.title: The Tenth Man
titles.plot: A man (Alan Sabbagh) spends time with a woman (Julieta Zylberberg) who works for his father's charitable foundation in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

titles.title: The Exploding Girl
titles.plot: A college student (Zoe Kazan) considers a romance with her longtime best friend (Mark Rendall).

titles.title: Father of the Bride
titles.plot: You are enthusiastically invited to the love, the food, the music and the fun of "Father of the Bride," a modern rom-com updated from the timeless classic. This sparkling story of a family and its unbreakable bonds illustrates the surprising and funny ways the heart can adapt in the name of love.

titles.title: Feather Christmas
titles.plot: For single dad, and veterinarian, Martin, Christmas is all about upholding regular family traditions to keep the memory of his late wife alive. But when an ailing pet chicken arrives at his home-run animal sanctuary, the family's festive plans, and entire world, are turned upside down, as new love blossoms and spreads its wings!

titles.title: For Worse
titles.plot: Lauren, a newly divorced, sober mom, feels like she has a new lease on life after joining her first acting class and starting a fling with her hot, young scene partner. However, when they attend their Gen Z classmate's wedding together, things begin to fall apart, and Lauren finds herself behaving like a drunk 25-year-old bridesmaid. Luckily after a disastrous night she stumbles into a new day and a new beginning.

titles.title: Redoubtable
titles.plot: During the making of one of his films, French film director Jean-Luc Godard falls in love with 17-year-old actress Anne Wiazemsky and later marries her.

titles.title: Golden Voices
titles.plot: Raya and Victor built a shared career as the Soviet Union's most beloved film dubbers. As the USSR collapses, the Jewish couple must immigrate to Israel and reinvent themselves to find employment. A charming comedy about disrupting dynamics, starting anew, and rediscovering yourself in the most unexpected places, GOLDEN VOICES is also a stirring tribute to the redemptive power of cinema.

titles.title: Hank and Asha
titles.plot: An Indian woman studying in Prague corresponds with a young filmmaker in New York. As their relationship intensifies, they must choose whether to meet.

titles.title: Heart's Creek
titles.plot: After a car accident, a young event planner finds herself lost in the Rocky Mountains, only to be rescued by a handsome mountain guide on horseback.

titles.title: Holiday
titles.plot: Johnny (Cary Grant) seems like a solid match for Julia (Doris Nolan), the socialite daughter of Edward Seton (Henry Kolker). Assured that Johnny is a worthy suitor, Edward approves of the pairing. But, as Johnny's wanderlust surfaces -- he is more interested in traveling than in business -- Edward starts to have doubts. Johnny also begins to wonder if he might not be a better match for Linda (Katharine Hepburn), Julia's outspoken younger sister, with whom he has much more in common.

titles.title: Holy Irresistible
titles.plot: After Ivy's parents were killed by a minivan and his Uncle was struck by a bolt of lightning, it spawned a bitter relationship with God. But when Ivy falls for the local preacher's daughter, he can't resist infiltrating her church to convince her he's a true believer.

titles.title: In Stereo
titles.plot: After a chance meeting, a self-destructive artist (Micah Hauptman) and his ex-girlfriend (Beau Garrett) try to figure out a way to be together without getting back together.

titles.title: In the Aisles
titles.plot: A man gets a new job in a supermarket and falls in love with his married co-worker.

titles.title: It Happened One Night
titles.plot: In Frank Capra's acclaimed romantic comedy, spoiled heiress Ellie Andrews impetuously marries the scheming King Westley, leading her tycoon father to spirit her away on his yacht. After jumping ship, Ellie falls in with cynical newspaper reporter Peter Warne, who offers to help her reunite with her new husband in exchange for an exclusive story. But during their travels, the reporter finds himself falling for the feisty young heiress.

titles.title: Limit
titles.plot: Three people reminisce while sailing without direction.

titles.title: Little Box of Sweets
titles.plot: A young woman fights for her dreams and the man of her dreams.

titles.title: Looop Lapeta
titles.plot: When her boyfriend loses a mobster's cash, Savi races against the clock to save the day -- if only she can break out of a curious cycle of dead ends.

titles.title: Love Is All You Need
titles.plot: In Italy for her daughter's (Molly Blixt Egelind) wedding, a woman (Trine Dyrholm) bonds with her future in-law (Pierce Brosnan).

titles.title: Meenakshi Sundareshwar
titles.plot: Forced to live apart due to a unique job prospect, two newlyweds face the hassles, hiccups -- and hilarity -- that arise from their long-distance marriage.

titles.title: Meet Me in Montenegro
titles.plot: While in Berlin to meet an actor, a filmmaker (Alex Holdridge) reconnects with a dancer (Linnea Saasen) who broke his heart years earlier.

titles.title: My Brother's Bride
titles.plot: A man (Imran Khan) falls in love with the bride (Katrina Kaif) of his London-based soon-to-be-married brother (Ali Zafar).

images.caption: Katrina Kaif and Imran Khan in "Mere Brother Ki Dulhan."
(L-R) Imran Khan, Katrina Kaif, and Ali Zafar in "Mere Brother Ki Dulhan."

titles.title: Missed Connections
titles.plot: After an unforgettable encounter, a hopeless romantic turns to an app to seek out a man she just met -- but is he really what she's looking for?

titles.title: One Small Hitch
titles.plot: Lifelong friends (Shane McRae, Aubrey Dollar) fake their engagement to make one's dying father happy, but the ruse gets out of hand when they start falling in love for real.

titles.title: Pyaar Impossible
titles.plot: A geeky young man is paired together with the most beautiful girl in college through a twist of fate, leaving a strange but great love to blossom.

images.caption: (L-R) Priyanka Chopra and Uday Chopra in "Pyaar Impossible."

titles.title: A Random Desi Romance
titles.plot: Raghu is a commitment-phobic who absconds from his wedding and meets Gayatri, who soon becomes his live-in girlfriend.

titles.title: Someone Marry Barry
titles.plot: Friends try to find a wife for their obnoxious buddy (Tyler Labine), but their plan backfires when his new girlfriend (Lucy Punch) turns out to be just as socially inappropriate.

titles.title: Spring Blossom
titles.plot: Suzanne (Suzanne Lindon) is sixteen. She is bored with people her own age. From the outside, everything appears lovely in her charmed world, but the everyday monotony of school and her relationships with friends and family feels completely uninspired. Every day on her way to high school, she passes a theater. There, she meets a 35-year-old actor named Raphaël (Arnaud Valois, BPM (Beats Per Minute )). Despite their age difference they find in each other an answer to their ennui and develop a strong connection. Immersed in the world of grown-ups and adult choices, Suzanne begins questioning the pitfalls of blossoming too quickly and missing out on life -- the life of a 16-year-old, which she had struggled so much to enjoy in the same way as her peers.

titles.title: Stella's Last Weekend
titles.plot: The bond between two brothers is challenged when they find they are in love with the same girl.

titles.title: #Stuck
titles.plot: Guy and Holly's steamy one-night stand turns into an awkward morning when they become stuck in a traffic jam and have to get to know each other.

titles.title: Tamasha
titles.plot: A man (Ranbir Kapoor) falls in love with a woman (Deepika Padukone) after spending one week with her on the French island of Corsica.

titles.title: Tanner Hall
titles.plot: A manipulative childhood acquaintance (Georgia King) worms her way into a teenager's (Rooney Mara) circle of friends at an all-girls boarding school.

titles.title: The Groomsmen Last Dance
titles.plot: Jackson moves to Italy to be near his daughter, but a chance meeting with café owner Gabriella, and some meddling friends, may lead to a second chance at love.

titles.title: The Red Shoes: Next Step
titles.plot: Samantha Cavanaugh is about to dance the lead role in the Red Shoes when she takes a congratulatory Facetime call from her sister, Annie, who has been picked up by the New York City Ballet. What should be a moment of mutual celebration turns into a shared nightmare when Annie is struck by a car. Traumatized and stricken with guilt, Sam quits dancing, leaves Harlow’s Academy, and returns to her local High School where she renews her friendship with Eve, an alternative indie-punk chick. A blur of grief-stricken partying and misbehavior spins Sam’s life further out of control and a shoplifting spree lands the girls with two-hundred hours of community service each. Sam’s mother, Jennifer, concerned that Eve is largely responsible for the extremes of her daughter’s current behavior, is desperate for Sam to find her ‘normal’ again, and Sam is sent back to the Academy to serve her two- hundred hours there - cleaning the studios and facilities and attending regular study sessions - but not dancing. Sam’s return is difficult. There are constant reminders of her sister - trophies, images, inescapable memories that make Annie a living presence for Sam - an accusatory reminder of the tragedy. What’s more, the students are rehearsing The Red Shoes again, this time with Ben Shelby, an old friend of Annie’s and Sam’s, in the lead male role. Ben is on loan from NYC Ballet. He’s partnering Gracie, the Academy’s new star pupil and Sam’s old rival.

titles.plot: A Frenchman feels torn between honor and his love for his daughter when she gets into trouble with the wealthy son of a shopkeeper.

titles.title: UNindian
titles.plot: A beautiful Indian single mother living in Australia causes a scandal in her family when she falls in love with a white man.

titles.title: Vacationland
titles.plot: A high-school senior (Brad Hallowell) ditches his girlfriend for a gay romance with his best friend.

titles.title: Vanilla
titles.plot: A freewheeling comedienne, determined to save her family business, persuades an uptight entrepreneur to go on an extended first date - a road trip to New Orleans to sell a van with a complicated history.

titles.title: Wedding Pullav
titles.plot: Old friends discover romantic feelings for each other just as one of them is set to be married.

titles.title: Weekenders
titles.plot: A scheduling mix-up at an Airbnb brings four twenty-somethings together, each navigating the open waters of where, how, and with whom they're supposed to be.

titles.title: Wobble Palace
titles.plot: A week before the 2016 election, a couple on the verge of breaking up decide to split their home over the weekend and test the waters of independence.

titles.title: Wuthering Heights
titles.plot: A poor English boy is taken in by a wealthy family where he develops an intense relationship with his younger foster sister.
